releaseNote.summary: PythonTask now calls the domain's own Python runtime container from Orchestration over Dapr; Python, pythonnet and the Kubernetes client are removed from the Execution image.

migrations.title: PythonTask config moves from inline script to a handler reference
migrations.description: PythonTask (type 23) no longer carries code. config.script and config.executionMode are gone; config.handler names a handler registered in the domain's Python runtime image (built FROM ghcr.io/burgan-tech/vnext/python-runtime), config.input and config.timeoutSeconds stay, and the standard InputHandler/OutputHandler mapping now runs. The Execution host's Python section (Python:*) and its pythonNet, process and container modes are removed. The type was experimental, disabled by default and absent from vnext-schema.
migrations.action: Move each Python script into a handler module of the domain's runtime image, replace config.script with config.handler, enable the runtime in the Helm chart (it sets Workflow:PythonRuntime:AppId), and drop Python:* settings from Execution overrides.
